Headline: Interim Administration Outlines Electoral & Constitutional Reform Commission Mandates
Author: Senior Political Affairs Correspondent & Judicial Bureau Desk
Main_Subject: Six State Reform Commissions, 90-day reporting mandates, and electoral roll audits
Summary: Details Chief Adviser Prof. Muhammad Yunus's Sept 11, 2024 announcement and subsequent gazette establishing six reform commissions (Constitution, Election, Police, Judiciary, Public Admin, ACC) commencing Oct 1, 2024 with an initial 90-day mandate.

Headline: IMF World Economic Outlook: Global Growth Steady at 3.2% Amid Disinflation Trajectories and Debt Pressures
Author: Craig Stirling & Enda Curran
Pub_Type: Global Financial Wire & Multilateral Economic Assessment
Main_Subject: IMF October 2024 WEO GDP projections (3.2%) and companion Fiscal Monitor ($100T debt)
Summary: Documents IMF October 2024 WEO projecting 3.2% global real GDP growth in 2024 and 2025 alongside disinflation from 6.7% to 4.3%, while the companion Fiscal Monitor warns global public debt will surpass $100 trillion (~93% of GDP).

Headline: Attention Is All You Need: How the Transformer Architecture Revolutionized Natural Language Processing and Modern AI
Author: Will Douglas Heaven (analyzing Vaswani et al., 2017)
Main_Subject: Transformer architecture, self-attention complexity, WMT14 BLEU scores, and training compute
Summary: Evaluates the landmark NeurIPS 2017 paper 'Attention Is All You Need' by Vaswani et al., analyzing how multi-head self-attention replaced RNNs/CNNs, achieved 28.4 BLEU (En-De) and 41.8 BLEU (En-Fr) on 8 P100 GPUs in 3.5 days, and scales at O(n^2 * d).

Headline: WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2024: Record Diagnostic Levels of 8.2M Reached as Severe Funding Gaps Persist
Publisher: World Health Organization (WHO) / The Lancet Infectious Diseases
Author: WHO Global Tuberculosis Programme (Dr. Tereza Kasaeva)
Pub_Type: Multilateral Public Health Agency Epidemiological Dossier
Main_Subject: Global TB incidence (10.8M), diagnoses (8.2M), mortality (1.25M), and $5.7B vs $22B funding gap
Summary: Reports 8.2 million newly diagnosed TB cases in 2023 (highest since 1995), 1.25 million deaths surpassing COVID-19, 56% burden concentrated in five countries, and only $5.7B available against a $22B annual target.

Headline: COP29 Baku Climate Summit Concludes with $300 Billion Annual Climate Finance Deal by 2035 Amid Developing Nation Frustrations
Author: Matt McGrath & Fiona Harvey
Pub_Type: International Diplomatic Wire & UN Treaty Record
Main_Subject: COP29 New Collective Quantified Goal (NCQG) $300B core pledge and $1.3T wider goal by 2035
Summary: Details the COP29 NCQG agreement in Baku setting a $300B/yr mobilization pledge by 2035 led by developed nations alongside a wider $1.3T/yr aspirational target, Article 6.4 carbon market rules, and G77/India plenary objections.
